description: Household time watched-consumer: reads the resolver at the conventional home gateway, applies only a fresh valid timezone, and always ensures NTP.

args:
state=$(/usr/bin/curl -fsS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 http://homeserver.home.arpa:3014/time/state 2>/dev/null || true)
zone=$(printf '%s' "$state" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import datetime,json,sys
try:
 d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=d.get("state",d); z=s.get("timezone"); v=s.get("valid_until"); now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc); valid=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(v.replace("Z","+00:00")) if isinstance(v,str) else None; print(z if isinstance(z,str) and valid and valid>now else "")
except Exception: pass')
if [ -n "$zone" ]; then
  /usr/local/bin/caduceus time set-timezone "$zone"
else
  printf '%s\n' 'household-time-peer-state-unavailable-or-stale' >&2
fi
